tldr: Mercury in Virgo: the mind is precise, analytical, and built for useful discernment.
body: With Mercury in Virgo, Mercury is at home and exalted, so thinking can be clear, practical, and exact. You communicate best when details matter and improvement is possible.
gift: Analysis, editing, craft, practical advice, and the ability to solve real problems.
challenge: Overcriticism, worry, and using detail as a shield against action.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
